content.short: Sharpe is a Self-Custodial DeFi SuperApp for Power Users and Institutions.
content.description: Since its 2021 introduction, Sharpe has pursued an enterprise‑grade DeFi automation and execution platform that enables users to manage, track, invest, and automate their DeFi assets. It operates within a fully self‑custodial environment and supports any wallet, preserving user control while accessing DeFi opportunities. Built on the Safe architecture and the ERC‑4337 stack, Sharpe reimagines DeFi interaction and enhances the user experience for advanced on‑chain executions and on‑chain yields.
